description: The topics you may read on CarlNotes, Carl's app: the public ones for everyone, plus what a connected account owns, follows, and holds through a team. A section lists one section of the topics page: yours, followed, featured, or popular. similar_to_topic_id lists the similar topics a topic's page shows. Use it when the user asks Carl or CarlNotes for topics, with phrases like list my topics, what topics do I follow, what is popular, topics like this one, or what does Carl cover.

cursor.description: The cursor a previous page returned.

section.description: One section of the topics page. A visitor reads featured and popular.

similar_to_topic_id.description: A topic whose similar topics to list.
